title: Landing angle at C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the angle between velocity and horizontal at point C as 45° from projectile motion components.

title: Pressure magnitude at D
description: Essential: Correctly determines the magnitude of pressure exerted on the track at point D as 100 N using centripetal force and Newton's laws.

title: Initial velocity for no collision
description: Essential: Correctly finds the initial velocity leaving the platform for smooth entry into circular track as 4 m/s.

title: AB shortening distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the shortened distance of segment AB as 0.3 m from horizontal displacement difference.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important: Sets up correct projectile motion equations relating vertical displacement (h-h_C), time, and velocities.

title: Energy/work on rough segment
description: Important: Applies work-energy or kinematics with friction to find velocity at D from stopping distance on DE.

title: Centripetal force at D
description: Important: Uses Newton's second law with centripetal acceleration to find normal force at point D.

title: Tangent condition for entry
description: Important: Recognizes that for smooth entry at C, velocity must be tangent to circular track (v_y/v_0 = tanθ).

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in projectile equations, centripetal force direction, or energy/work signs.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and converts appropriately.
